B62="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0 -2 -1 0 -4

B=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in B62.strip().split("\n")]); IDX={c:i for i,c in enumerate(B62_ORDER)}
def enc(s): return np.array([IDX.get(c,IDX['X']) for c in s])
def pid(s1,s2,gap=11):
    a,b=enc(s1),enc(s2); n,m=len(a),len(b)
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),-10**6,dtype=np.int64); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8)
    M[0,:]=-gap*np.arange(m+1); P[0,1:]=2; jr=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        sub=B[a[i-1],b]; diag=M[i-1,:-1]+sub; up=M[i-1,1:]-gap
        t=np.empty(m+1,dtype=np.int64); t[0]=-gap*i; t[1:]=np.maximum(diag,up)
        ptr=np.zeros(m+1,dtype=np.int8); ptr[1:]=np.where(diag>=up,0,1); ptr[0]=1
        row=np.maximum.accumulate(t+gap*jr)-gap*jr
        P[i]=np.where(row>t,2,ptr); M[i]=row
    i,j,idn,col=n,m,0,0
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i>0 and j>0 and P[i,j]==0: col+=1; idn+=(s1[i-1]==s2[j-1]); i-=1; j-=1
        elif i>0 and (j==0 or P[i,j]==1): i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return 100.0*idn/col
def uni(a):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30); return "".join(r.text.split("\n")[1:])

REFS=[("W. succinogenes WS0167\n(PDB 4INA, apo, function unassigned)","Q7MSS8","eps-CASDH clade"),
      ("H. pylori CASDH HP_1507\n(structure + NADP, no substrate)","O26037","eps-CASDH clade"),
      ("B. fragilis CASDH\n(PDB 8DEB, + NADP, no substrate)","I9VY56","other CASDH"),
      ("V. alginolyticus CANSDH\n(assayed, 1,3-diaminopropane)","P0DPE4","CANSDH clade"),
      ("V. cholerae CANSDH VC_1624\n(deletion: loses nspd + spd)","Q9KRL3","CANSDH clade"),
      ("Blastochloris HSS\n(homospermidine synthase)","O32323","other family"),
      ("Pyrococcus PH1688 SDH","O59312","true saccharopine DH"),
      ("S. cerevisiae Lys9 (EC 1.5.1.10)","P38999","true saccharopine DH"),
      ("S. cerevisiae Lys1 (EC 1.5.1.7)","P38998","true saccharopine DH")]
q = uni("Q0PBW7")
vals=[]; 
for lab,acc,grp in REFS:
    vals.append((lab, pid(q, uni(acc)), grp))
res = pd.DataFrame(vals, columns=["reference","pct_identity_to_Cj0172c","group"]).sort_values("pct_identity_to_Cj0172c", ascending=True)
print(res.to_string(index=False))

# ---------- figure ----------
cols={"eps-CASDH clade":"#2d6a4f","other CASDH":"#52b788","CANSDH clade":"#e07a5f",
      "other family":"#8d99ae","true saccharopine DH":"#b5179e"}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2,1, figsize=(11.5,10), gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1.55,1]})

ax=axes[0]
ax.barh(range(len(res)), res["pct_identity_to_Cj0172c"], color=[cols[g] for g in res["group"]])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(res))); ax.set_yticklabels(res["reference"], fontsize=8.2)
for i,v in enumerate(res["pct_identity_to_Cj0172c"]): ax.text(v+0.8, i, f"{v:.1f}%", va="center", fontsize=8.5)
ax.axvline(25, ls="--", c="grey", lw=1); ax.text(25.6, -0.75, "twilight zone (25%)", fontsize=7.5, color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("% identity to Cj0172c (Q0PBW7), global Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, gap 11")
ax.set_xlim(0,80)
ax.set_title("Cj0172c is a carboxypolyamine dehydrogenase, not a saccharopine dehydrogenase;\n"
             "its closest relatives with structures carry NADP but no amine substrate", fontsize=11)
hs=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=c) for c in cols.values()]
ax.legend(hs, cols.keys(), fontsize=7.5, loc="lower right", frameon=False)

ax=axes[1]
genes=[("Cj0169",166373,167035,"+","superoxide dismutase"),("Cj0170",167050,167794,"+","methyltransferase"),
       ("Cj0172c",167807,169012,"-","carboxypolyamine DH"),("Cj0173c",169054,169962,"-","Fe-ABC ATPase"),
       ("Cj0174c",169946,171562,"-","Fe-ABC permease"),("Cj0175c",171562,172566,"-","Fe-ABC binding prot."),
       ("Cj0176c",172563,172694,"-","lipoprotein"),("Cj0177",172916,173767,"+","iron transport")]

    ax.add_patch(FancyArrow(x, y, dx, 0, width=0.085, head_width=0.13, head_length=190,
                            length_includes_head=True, color=col))
    ax.text((s+e)/2, y+0.16 if st=="+" else y-0.22, f"{name}\n{prod}", ha="center", fontsize=7.4)
ax.annotate("42 bp", xy=(169033,0.2), xytext=(169033,0.42), fontsize=7.5, ha="center",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", lw=0.8))
